Let’s look at practice design, not just content, so the work you’re already doing actually raises your anxiety tolerance between sessions.

Complement with paced-breath HRV biofeedback at your resonance frequency if you’ll train it regularly; unlike one-off soothing tracks, repeated biofeedback has shown reductions in trait anxiety and improved autonomic flexibility (per Lehrer & Gevirtz 2014). Most apps optimize for easy calm and streaks; optimize for difficult, variable, no-escape reps, and your nervous system starts carrying the gains into lunch.
